svg.title: About Eren Kurular — final-year Digital Game Design student at İstanbul Bilgi University, president of Bilgi Espor Club.

g.text: I’m in my final year of Digital Game Design at İstanbul Bilgi
University. Most of my time goes into Unity and C#: gameplay
systems, game economies and the small tools that make them
I like working across the whole project — code, level design and
some 3D modelling and animation in Blender — because a game
only feels right when those parts agree with each other.
Outside my own projects I’m the president of the Bilgi Espor Club,
where I organize events and bring industry guests to campus.
Unity & C# daily · Unreal (Blueprints) · Godot (GDScript) · Blender · Python
Lead the board, run event planning and organize
Focus: game studies, ludology, narratology and
